Name: (AT) A Better-Looking Plasma TV for Alternative Textures
Author: petitepaddingtonbear
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/uaeKx5s.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[font=Arial][size=4]The basic Plasma TV is basic, boring, bleh! Spruce up your home with these five Plasma TV textures made by Vickamoose and converted to Alternative Textures.
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=5]
[u]Featuring:[/u][/size][/font][font=Verdana][size=5][u]

[/u][/size][/font][font=Verdana][size=4]Five flavors of Plasma TV, including [b]brown[/b], [b]beige[/b], [b]white[/b], [b]glass: gold[/b], and [b]glass: black[/b]. [b]
[/b][/size][/font][left]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7wnJ7F2.png[/img][/left][list=1]
[*][size=4][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]! [/size]
[*][size=4]If you do not know how to install mods to use with SMAPI, reference [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]this player guide[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=4]Download the mod file and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, or use a Mod Manager to download and install.[/size]
[*][size=4][b]Make sure you have Alternative Textures installed.[/b][/size]


[*][size=4]Run the game using SMAPI, and enjoy![/size]
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/1S3dggr.png[/img][left][size=5][b]This mod should be compatible with everything.[/b][/size]
[size=4]
I can be contacted on Discord at beary#3675 with any inquiries!
50% of Donation Points for this mod will go to a charity of my choice.
[/size][/left]
